title: Bill Richardson siphoning US nuclear secrets
place_text: Los Alamos / Department of Energy, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Bill Richardson was kind of in with the Clintons and he was a Secretary of Energy and he's there and he's just systematically siphoning American nuclear secrets.

plain: In the 1990s, Bill Richardson, a Secretary of Energy close to the Clintons, was "systematically siphoning American nuclear secrets", according to Michels, who says this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about Bob Lazar, a man who claims to have worked on alien craft. If true, it would mean the official in charge of the nation's nuclear labs was leaking from them.
